content.value: Hi there,
Dust’s mission is to make work "work better" by enabling anyone to equip themselves with generative AI, without needing to rely on engineers.
Here's a roundup of the latest features we've rolled out to help you work smarter and make the most of your AI agents.
♊️ Gemini 1.5 pro
You can now access
Gemini 1.5 pro
, Google's latest model via the new @gemini-pro agent. Gemini 1.5 pro has the largest context window (1 million tokens = several Harry Potter books 📚).
SOC2 Type II Compliance Achieved
We're officially SOC2 - Type II compliant, underscoring our unwavering commitment to data security and operational excellence. Visit our
Trust Center
to download our SOC2 report.
Multi-File Upload for Folders
Uploading multiple files, including PDFs, to your Folders is now a breeze.
Simplified Data Source Selection
We have revamped the way we present Data Sources, with grouped folders and the ability to search across websites you've connected.
💬 Dust can be used in Slack workflows

Enable custom interactions between Slack workflows and Dust agents. For example, you can now schedule agents to message at particular times and trigger a reply from an agent when a specific emoji reaction is used...
This functionality requires whitelisting, so ping us at
support@dust.tt
if you'd like to try it out.
Mermaid Diagrams Support
You can now create and render Mermaid diagrams directly within Dust. This feature opens up new possibilities for visualizing data and processes in a straightforward, text-based format.
➕ And much more...
Our Pro Plan now includes a 14-day free trial; let your friends know!
Learn more about
Dario’s successful rollout of Dust
at November Five.
We now suggest ✨ names and descriptions to facilitate agent creation.
Rename websites connected as Data Sources for easier navigation.
As an admin, invite multiple members to your workspace at once.
We hope these updates enhance your Dust experience and empower you to achieve more with AI agents.
Stay tuned for more!
CTA -
Tell us how you feel about Dust in 5 questions
The Dust Team
PS: We're always here to help! Feel free to send us an email with questions or feedback.
